diagnosis: Customer is questioning the first invoice after a mid-cycle upgrade to the Business plan. The invoice total differs from the standard list price due to proration.
reply: Thank you for reaching out. When an account upgrades mid-billing cycle, the remaining days on the previous plan are prorated as a credit, and a charge for the new plan is issued on a combined invoice. Because of this, the total for the first invoice may differ from the standard plan list price. For more details, please see our guide on Understanding mid-cycle proration on plan upgrades (kb-0001).
